operator-walkthrough.ref: Admin UI v1 Wave 0 is invisible until a read fails. Admin, Today: BEFORE, when the overview bundle failed, the red banner said 'The stats pipeline threw inside getDashboardStats() ... Check Sentry / Railway logs' and the Needs action card below it still read 'All clear', Bookings today and Urgent leads read 0, and the morning brief said 'Now: all clear'. AFTER: the banner says 'Some of today's numbers couldn't be loaded. The counts below may be incomplete; treat them as unknown, not zero.' with a Retry button, the three cards read a dash with 'Unable to determine', and the brief says 'Now: queue unknown, the overview read failed'. 'Open work order' in the queue now opens Money (Shop Pulse, where work orders render) instead of the Customers list. Admin, Customers: a failed list shows 'Customers couldn't load. The list is unknown, not empty.' with Retry instead of an empty table; failed stats tiles show a dash and 'Unable to determine' instead of 0 and $0; the header line says 'Customer stats couldn't load, state unknown' instead of vanishing; in a profile, the Interactions, Service history, Declined and Backlog tabs show an error line with Retry instead of 'No ... found'. Admin, Instagram: a failed held-reel read shows a '?' badge titled 'Held reels unknown: read failed' instead of hiding the badge. Admin, Voice Receptionist: 'Today's calls couldn't load, state unknown, not empty' with Retry instead of 'No calls yet today'. Admin, Call Tracking: the five tiles show a dash and one amber line instead of 0 / 0 / 0. Admin, Outreach, Win-back: six tiles show a dash and one amber line instead of 0. /admin/ad-studio: 'Post now' asks 'Post this carousel to Instagram now?' first and reads 'Posted' (disabled) after success; Copy caption reports a clipboard failure. A section crash now names the section ('The Tires section failed.') instead of its registry id. Verified by client/src/__tests__/admin-w0-honesty.test.tsx (25 tests; 17 red on the unfixed code, 25 of 25 single-line mutants killed by the lane, 3 of 3 re-checked by the manager) and admin-ui-v1-ratchets.test.ts (manager probe: seven planted violations in Admin.tsx raised every counter by the expected delta, UPDATE_RATCHET=1 refused the raise, CI refused init). Not screenshot-verified: the screens are behind admin auth and admin e2e skips without E2E_ADMIN_STORAGE_STATE.
